sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this transparent 4x4 directional archer action atlas. Make all figures uniformly smaller to achieve this, do NOT crop weapons or limbs. Restore any clipped bow tip in the top row. No overlap across cells. Same body size and foot baseline within every row. Rows from top: NE rear upper-right; SE front lower-right; SW front lower-left; NW rear upper-left. Columns: relaxed guard with bow lowered; fully drawn bow with nocked arrow; just released with drawing hand back and NO arrow in bow; relaxed recovery. Keep actual different poses and directions, no mirroring. No ground, shadows, panels, letters, numbers, grid lines or other items.

This is a runtime animation asset, full thrust visibly differs from idle. Avoid spanning any weapon into neighboring cell.
